The /agents/tasks/list API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

AgentTaskListResponse Model - Response wrapping the list of agent tasks for an organization.
success boolean
Indicate if the API request was successful.
errors string Array
List of errors with the API call.
tasks AgentTask Array
Agent tasks belonging to the organization.
Example 
{
  "success": true,
  "errors": [
    "string"
  ],
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": 332,
      "name": "Print Hello World Message",
      "organizationId": "string",
      "agentId": 47,
      "prompt": "string",
      "deployments": 0,
      "lastDeploymentId": 0,
      "lastDeploymentTime": "2026-05-06 19:09:52",
      "created": "2026-05-06 19:22:25",
      "updated": "2026-05-06 19:22:26",
      "projectId": 0,
      "owner": {
        "publicId": "alexandre_catarino",
        "name": "Alexandre Catarino",
        "image": "e76004d3a79bb421536616863.jpeg"
      },
      "upcomingDeployments": [
        {}
      ],
      "status": [
        {
          "deploymentId": "A-dc29abb48861866874f695798925f9d2",
          "status": "Running"
        }
      ],
      "schedule": "string",
      "scheduleHuman": "string",
      "projectPreference": "project-each-task-deployment",
      "notifications": [
        {}
      ]
    }
  ]
}
AgentTask Model - An agent task definition.
id integer
example: 332
Identifier of the task.
name string
example: Print Hello World Message
Name of the task.
organizationId string
Identifier of the organization that owns the task.
agentId integer
example: 47
Identifier of the agent the task uses.
prompt string
Prompt the agent will execute when deployed.
deployments integer
Number of times this task has been deployed.
lastDeploymentId integer
nullable
Numeric Id of the most recent deployment, or null if never deployed.
lastDeploymentTime string
nullable
example: 2026-05-06 19:09:52
Timestamp of the most recent deployment.
created string
example: 2026-05-06 19:22:25
Creation timestamp.
updated string
example: 2026-05-06 19:22:26
Last-updated timestamp.
projectId integer
nullable
Identifier of the project bound to the task, when one exists.
owner AgentTaskOwner object
Owner of an agent task.
upcomingDeployments object Array
nullable
Pending scheduled deployments, when the task has a schedule.
status AgentTaskStatusEntry Array
Statuses of the task's currently active deployments.
schedule string
nullable
Cron expression that schedules the task, when one is set.
scheduleHuman string
nullable
Human-readable description of the schedule.
projectPreference string Enum
How projects are mapped to deployments of this task. Options : ['project-each-task-deployment', 'project-for-task']
notifications object Array
Notification targets configured for the task.
Example 
{
  "id": 332,
  "name": "Print Hello World Message",
  "organizationId": "string",
  "agentId": 47,
  "prompt": "string",
  "deployments": 0,
  "lastDeploymentId": 0,
  "lastDeploymentTime": "2026-05-06 19:09:52",
  "created": "2026-05-06 19:22:25",
  "updated": "2026-05-06 19:22:26",
  "projectId": 0,
  "owner": {
    "publicId": "alexandre_catarino",
    "name": "Alexandre Catarino",
    "image": "e76004d3a79bb421536616863.jpeg"
  },
  "upcomingDeployments": [
    {}
  ],
  "status": [
    {
      "deploymentId": "A-dc29abb48861866874f695798925f9d2",
      "status": "Running"
    }
  ],
  "schedule": "string",
  "scheduleHuman": "string",
  "projectPreference": "project-each-task-deployment",
  "notifications": [
    {}
  ]
}
AgentTaskOwner Model - Owner of an agent task.
publicId string
example: alexandre_catarino
Public profile slug of the user.
name string
example: Alexandre Catarino
Display name of the user.
image string
example: e76004d3a79bb421536616863.jpeg
Filename of the user's profile image.
Example 
{
  "publicId": "alexandre_catarino",
  "name": "Alexandre Catarino",
  "image": "e76004d3a79bb421536616863.jpeg"
}
AgentTaskStatusEntry Model - Status entry for one of a task's active deployments.
deploymentId string
example: A-dc29abb48861866874f695798925f9d2
Identifier of an associated deployment.
status string
example: Running
Current status of the deployment.
Example 
{
  "deploymentId": "A-dc29abb48861866874f695798925f9d2",
  "status": "Running"
}

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
Header
